authority.boundary: R13 and R14 put the data-bit boundary after the handle and EED. Only R14 has the extra DICTIONARY RC; cloning and hard-owner fields are R2000+ DWG fields.

source.qualification: Locally authored generated control; timestamps may change its hash. Not a native producer or consumer witness.

changes: Extract shared R13/R14 source framing, bounded text, alignment, dictionary and handle-role checks, and reuse them in the existing R14 output proof.

Bind generated AC1012 dictionary and standard MLINESTYLE source frames to the captured typed identities; test R13/R14 byte boundary, mutated role and every dictionary bit, and the unsupported-version boundary.

Keep AC1012 MLINESTYLE strict output refused pending absent-source cloning/ownership and native duplicate-merge semantics; test destination preservation and explicit partial readback in both encodings.

independentPeer.observation: The reader identifies AC1012 and returns a successful operation; complete conversion stops at a separate exact-version ModelDocViewStyle output guard. This is not evidence of that profile's output completeness.

nativeNextStep: tools/research/AC1012_DICTIONARY_NATIVE_WITNESS.md defines source, output-presence, mergeStyle, ownership, duplicate-operation, re-open and artifact controls for an identified AutoCAD/ObjectARX host. Host profile and a successful execution remain required.
limitations: This is source-bound readiness and an explicit partial route, not complete AC1012 support or native interoperability. The prior ODA/LibreDWG cloning disagreement remains unresolved; no support claim or plan gate is promoted. No DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
